item.description:
IVE THE 1ST WORLD TOUR [SHOW WHAT I HAVE] (1080p HD)​


​
The SHOW WHAT I HAVE WORLD TOUR was the first worldwide concert tour and second tour overall by South Korean girl group IVE, in support of their extended plays I've Mine and Ive Switch. The tour began on October 7, 2023, in Seoul, South Korea and concluded on September 5, 2024, in Tokyo, Japan. The tour consisted of 37 concerts, including 21 in Asia, 6 in North America, 5 in Europe, 3 in Latin America and 2 in Oceania. On June 10, IVE announced that they would hold two encore shows at KSPO Dome on August 10–11.
